raw_message.reasoning:
Ah, the second `{name:l}` is a backreference to the first capture group, so it expects the exact same string. Since `(?P=name)` requires an exact match of what was captured, and we're parsing 'helloworld' with just `[a-zA-Z]+`, it captures all of 'helloworld' in the first group, then tries to match the empty string with `(?P=name)`, which fails.

This is expected behavior - repeated named fields require exact matches. Let me verify with a proper example:
